title: A .swerepo.toml from a newer SWERepo or standard loads, but an older SWERepo never overwrites it
assertion: A .swerepo.toml written by a newer SWERepo version, or in a newer standard, loads even when it names components this version doesn't know, but this older SWERepo refuses to save over it and leaves the file unchanged.

origin.text: Phase 1 behaviour, reviewed by Gemini in 3 rounds and strengthened after SeamSpec's reviewer explained the first drafts (ADR-20261120-ecf7); proposed for the owner to approve.
